item.title: 10 Cutest Sea Sheep Nudibranch Gifts Every Pet Parent Needs
item.description: Dive into Cuteness: Why Sea Sheep Nudibranchs Are Taking Over the Pet World If you thought traditional house pets held a monopoly on cuteness, think again. Meet the sea sheep nudibranch ( Costasiella kuroshimae )—a tiny, leaf-shaped marine slug with beady little eyes, adorable "sheep" horns, and the unique ability to photosynthesize.
